scope: Direct native port of the retained one-shot typed server ExecuteManeuver fixture as --maneuver-kick MPS; no new physics, autopilot block, shader, dependency or wire payload.

contract.ownership: apps/terrain-native/src/scene.rs::request_maneuver_kick queues exactly one thessa_flight_net::Command::ExecuteManeuver node (prograde along the acknowledged relative velocity, epoch = authority time + 20 s, 1<dv<=2000 m/s) through the existing remote command queue and normal wire input. The server validates and executes the plan on its own scheduler; the client never steps physics, fabricates burn observations or re-sends in a session.
contract.eligibility: Requires --server-flight (local mode has no executor and is rejected, never silently no-op). Sendable only with a live link, a healthy acknowledged flight and relative motion above 1 m/s; otherwise Ok(false) and the caller may retry. A stopped/stale replica never re-arms.
contract.one_shot: Sent at most once per session (maneuver_kick_sent); a repeated request returns success without queueing again. CLI startup waits for the first acknowledged moving snapshot within --server-timeout, then queues once.
contract.provenance: No local stepping (accumulator stays 0), no pose/force mutation and no fabricated air/force/load observations; a rejected plan surfaces in the server wake notice, never as client state. Warp, if requested, remains the shared server-owned time scale.
contract.cli: --maneuver-kick MPS: parsed before asset/GPU load; requires --server-flight; bounds (finite, 1<dv<=2000) validated at startup. Telemetry reports maneuver_kick_sent.

verification.other_gates: fmt, workspace all-features Clippy, native feature-off Clippy, architecture check, release viewer/server build, git diff check, muted 8-frame Wayland flight/HUD smoke, muted headless flight-deck capture, readout cost diagnostic, muted headless --flyby capture
verification.focused_checks: Wire regressions pin: local-mode rejection, retained bounds (0.5/1.0/2001/NaN/inf), not-yet-sent without a link, exact node content (epoch = authority + 20, prograde direction within 1e-9, |dv| exact), one-shot no-re-arm, zero local state/axis mutation, wire drain without re-queue, and waiting on a co-rotating/stopped replica. CLI regressions pin --maneuver-kick rejection without --server-flight, bad-value errors and help text. The ignored real-server test sends one kick through the real thessa-server, uses the shared warp to reach the 20 s epoch, and observes the server-owned executor driving engine/throttle with accumulator 0 and no fabricated loads.
verification.source_boundary: Previous 600-input flyby manifest plus main.rs, scene.rs, scene_server_tests.rs and presentation_args.rs; docs/evidence edits outside compiled inputs. No asset or dependency changes.
verification.hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics / RADV STRIX1 / Vulkan / Mesa 26.2.4-arch1.1

limitations: One-shot prograde kick fixture only: no maneuver-plan editing, node list UI, node removal or interactive editor (none existed in the retained client)
No local maneuver executor: --flight cannot run plans and is rejected instead of silently doing nothing
Guidance/target semantic inputs, ascent/landing/rendezvous blocks and remote trajectory transport remain unported
No WASM/Metal runtime acceptance, OS-level input injection or remote CI claim
Bevy retirement remains incomplete: part commands, remaining optics/render consumers and packaging/tooling still need replacement
